name: Sanesaram
body:
The sanesaram are mountain-dwelling dwarves native to the highlands of the Jade Oath lands. Living in communion with natural spirits and stone ghosts, they emphasize geomancy, ancestral balance, and unwavering stoicism.

Standard Racial Traits
Ability Score Racial Traits: Sanesaram are tough, perceptive, and spiritually grounded, but taciturn. They gain +2 Constitution, +2 Wisdom, and -2 Charisma.
Type: Humanoid (dwarf). Sanesaram are humanoids with the dwarf subtype.
Size: Medium. Sanesaram have no bonuses or penalties due to their size.
Base Speed: Slow and Steady. Sanesaram have a base speed of 20 feet, and their speed is never modified by armor or encumbrance.
Languages: Sanesaram begin play speaking Common and Dwarven. Bonus languages include Giant, Terran, Undercommon, and Goblin.
Senses and Defense Racial Traits
Darkvision: Sanesaram can see in the dark up to 60 feet.
Spirit Ward: Sanesaram receive a +2 racial bonus on saving throws against spells and spell-like abilities cast by undead or incorporeal creatures.
Hardy: Sanesaram gain a +2 racial bonus on saving throws against poison, spells, and spell-like abilities.
Stability: Sanesaram gain a +4 racial bonus to CMD when resisting a bull rush or trip attempt while standing firmly on ground.
Skill and Magic Racial Traits
Ghost Whisperer (Sp): Once per day, a sanesaram can communicate with the dead as if using speak with dead (caster level equal to character level), but can only ask one question of a corpse.
Stonecunning: Sanesaram receive a +2 bonus on Perception checks to notice unusual stonework.
